metadata.method_name: Safety Metric Evaluation on Qwen3-4B Lineage
metadata.description: Nine candidate safety metrics (ATC, WSSS, CLIF, MAS, ANG, AEN, LWCD, MLPS, RSD) plus logit-gap baseline evaluated on Qwen3-4B Base, SafeRL, and Abliterated models. Metrics measure internal activation differences between harmful and benign prompts. Random-weight controls verify signal is not spurious.
